text:
maya: heads up — after the runtime deploy at 10:02 UTC we started seeing 99p tail latency spikes on the continuous-batcher fleet. graphs look like sudden microbatch collapse + admission thrash. stack is prod-eu-2 :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
ash: i'm seeing the same on the dashboard, throughput drops ~20% for ~3m windows. linking the perf heatmap: https://internal/ops/perf/1765432100 :link:
kevin: quick dump of scheduler metrics attached:
```
admission_queue_length: 112 -> 18 -> 140
microbatch_size_p50: 48 -> 8 -> 52
microbatch_size_p99: 96 -> 12 -> 120
kv_prefetch_hits: 0.12 -> 0.02 -> 0.15
kernel_fallback_count: 7 -> 83 -> 9
```
li: kernel_fallback_count jump is interesting — looks like kernel-selector is flipping to the slower fused kernel repeatedly. maybe sequence-length estimator mispredicted and we hit a kernel that triggers high mem pressure so selector falls back?
maya: timeline matches our deploy that bumped the KV prefetch aggressiveness and changed sequence-length predictor to use a 2-step window. could be an interaction between prefetch evictions and kernel selection jitter.
nash: i ran a microprobe on a noisy host, saw repeated kv eviction logs: `kv_cache: evict shard 27 (prefetch=1)` every ~400ms. appears prefetch is thrashing hot shards.
kevin: if KV prefetch evicts hot entries, then the kernel's KV cache miss path will increase latency and cause the scheduler to shrink microbatches (less effective batching) which then changes the kernel choice — circular.
li: good summary. can we reproduce on staging? i spun up a small repro with synthetic seq length distribution + enabling new prefetcher flags, and i can trigger the oscillation within 30s. logs: `kernel_selector: selected fused_fast for kernel_hint=attn_fast; fallback->safe_fused after mem_high` repeated.
maya: suggestion: roll back the prefetch aggressiveness patch and keep the seq-length predictor change disabled until we have a coordinated test. we need quick mitigation in prod.
deploy-bot: rollback job started by maya at 10:18 UTC (job id job-1845).
nash: rollback in prod confirmed at 10:22 UTC, tail latency coming back down in the last minute. 99p dropped from 1.9s -> 310ms. :thumbsup:
kevin: follow-ups: add a short-circuit to the kernel-selector so it doesn't flip kernels more than once within a 5s window per model-shard. also add eviction metrics to the kernel selection debug traces.
li: i'll open a small RFC for coordinated change: (1) repro harness + stress test, (2) prefetch tuning matrix, (3) kernel-selector hysteresis, (4) better observability (per-shard evictions).
maya: can you tag me on the RFC, li? also add a simple SLO alert for microbatch_size_p50 regression > 30% for >2m.
li: will do. creating RFC and a postmortem note in incidents channel after we collect logs.
maya: thanks everyone — closing the immediate incident since rollback fixed prod. we'll track the RFC and the hysteresis patch next sprint.
